text:
Situation: Atracurium besylate is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 28 vials (8.3 days on hand) of NDC 55150021710, labeler AuroMedics Pharma LLC. Corvale General holds 95 vials (25.5 days on hand) of the same product.

Why (FDA record): The SPL set ID f7b6a720 for this NDC names Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspected that plant on 2026-02-06 and classified it OAI; the classification was posted on 2026-09-21. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2024-08-15 following an earlier OAI inspection.

Our position: No national shortage exists per FDA records. The supply risk is localized to the specific manufacturing site linked to our current NDC. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support an internal transfer without jeopardizing its own supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 20 vials of 100 mg/10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchasing from Hospira, Inc. as an alternate source — requires buyer approval; product is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
3. Evaluate purchasing from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. as an alternate source — requires buyer approval; product is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

Not recommended: No other actions at this time.
